verdict.tagline: Clever camouflage hide and seek wrapped in a surprisingly rough technical shell.
for_you_if: you enjoy tense rounds of hide and seek
you like using color matching mechanics to camouflage
you want to play on community created workshop maps
not_for_you_if: you need stable performance without crashes or severe lag
you are sensitive to technical issues and poor optimization
you want built in tutorials and seamless matchmaking

distortion_flags.sentence: Early impressions are sharply divided before turning positive among players with more time in matches.

cohorts.label: <2h refund window
cohorts.summary: Early players encounter severe performance crashes, missing tutorials, and security risks from custom workshop maps.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game lacks any keybind customization options.

citations.review_text:
The game is cool, but I don't know who made this; however, it is not for EUROPEANS. The game has no way to change keybinds, which means as someone who uses an AZERTY keyboard, it is impossible to play easily (some features are disabled). I am not a game dev, but hey, adding a way to change the keybinds might not be that hard.

Secondly, the game is not very well optimized; my PC is 5 years old but is still able to run insanely powerful games, yet I need to turn down every setting in this game to somehow play.

Lastly, the game is a bit confusing since the translations were made with AI, and there is no tutorial or stuff to train you.
No options to rebind controls, so I cannot play the game properly.
Good game, great concept but it is terribly optimized, UI can be improved greatly, cannot customize controls. Very unplayable game, very fixable but until it gets done i will be refunding it.

And to top it all off, the very first map I play, is won by a hacker who has somehow hidden inside the walls of the map, ensuring nobody would find them. Incredibly lame experience. If the dev can't be bothered to even give us a tutorial, I can't be bothered to play it. Refunded.

claims.claim: This cohort reports severe performance issues, severe lag, and crashes, even on lower graphics settings or capable hardware.

citations.review_text:
The game did not run well on my system, 30 fps at lowest settings, which is odd for a smaller game like this. The controls felt a bit clunky and cumbersome. There are some glitches.

Additionally, the game does not live up to the hype, it got boring after a round or two.
very laggy even with a gig internet speed server are very slow....cant even play the game

Unfortunately, game runs incredibly slow if you don't have a super expensive PC. even trying to use the 3d eyedropper can crash the game often, and this is with every graphic setting turned lowest. Unplayable for the most part. EDIT: No, the recent performance 'improvements' and performance mode did not help at all. I'd say the lag situation has gotten even worse, as now it's too laggy to even see if the eyedropper still crashes the game. At least I only wasted 6 bucks on this game lol. And it's not just a me issue, as literal DBD runs fine on my computer but this game doesn't. This game is insanely laggy.

Really fun concept and would've loved to be able to play it... 
But unfortunately I had major performance/stability issues.

The game would crash over and over at different stages of the game. 
Sometimes there was an Unreal Engine “GPU Crash Dump Triggered” error, and sometimes a black screen while the music kept playing.

-I tried lowering all graphics settings, verifying the files, and using DX11 launch options without success (all those minutes it was just me trying to play but the game kept crashing).

I know I have a potato, but it technically seems to meet the currently listed minimum requirements, although they're somewhat vague 👀.

Hopefully performance and optimization, improve with future updates for lower-end PCs too (and the minimum requirements become more specific, like for the CPU/GPU), because the game itself seems really fun :(

claims.claim: Reviewers describe encountering malware, trojans, or security breaches linked to downloading custom maps from the workshop.

citations.review_text:
BUYER BEWARE
Hackers were able to exploit the steam workshop mods to gain access to peoples data.
Requested refund after the whole security breech. 
My refund was denied, I asked twice. They stated that it didn't matter that there was a security  beech and due to me owning the title for longer than 2 weeks they could not refund me.
Removed game from my account instead.

I really want to love this game, it's really fun to play with friends, but I cannot trust it, while I can get past the bugs and clunky UI, I cannot ignore that the devs clearly just do not know what they're doing when it comes to proper security processes and while the game did blow up more than they probably expected, that's never an excuse for bad security practices.

This has had severe and dangerous consequences from remote code execution exploits to malware being packaged in the workshop due to improper filtering or prevention from the game running modded files in an unsafe way - this is something many other games with workshop support have dealt with so the devs are at fault for not protecting against it. That's just one thing, but also consider that the devs were incompetent enough to have their entire discord hacked and I just cannot trust that they care enough about security to manage a game at any scale, let alone this large.

Until things drastically change and they hire on a team of devs who actually know what they're doing and can properly keep their game secure, I will not be touching this game and I cannot recommend it.

The game itself is super fun.

However, a simple community map install, almost downloaded a trojan horse on my PC. 
Do not play this game in open lobbies that force you to download certain maps. 
Needs a hard fix. Cant recommend the game at this point untill its fixed.

Great game concept, rushed execution

The game has great potential, but it is at its present state still buggy and frustrating to play. The creators have suffered security breaches in their workshop and discord. Many users got infected with malware and potential malware in mods meant that I avoided modded maps. I've made adjustments to the game to reduce lag, but I still crash every time I try to use the eyedropper tool despite recent updates and quick fixes.

citations.review_text:
Easily in the top 5 best games I've played all year, and for only $5!! Easy to hop into a game, play a round, and hop off if you have limited time. Or you can play with friends and find endless amounts of laughter. 

Meccha Chameleon takes a very simple concept like hide and seek and evolves it into something much more interesting and replayable than simple prop hunt games. Utilizing an in-game color picker to (mostly) accurately paint your body to match the surrounding colors from wherever you're hiding, combined with gestures and cloning, the possibilities are infinite in where you can hide. 

But that's not the kicker: The Workshop is FULL of maps from your favorite games, allowing you to let loose your inner child and finally play hide-and-seek in Kakariko Village from Ocarina of Time or Bikini Bottom from Spongebob. Once again, all of this is only $5!!

It is definitely a work-in-progress, but the dev(s) has been updating the game almost daily and adding really interesting features that makes hiding even more fun. However, the UI and settings desperately need to be worked on with players spamming taunts, voice chat bugging out, the inability to turn down audio tracks tied to maps, etc...

All in all, amazing game. It's only $5 (that's less than a fast food meal) and it will give you endless hours of fun.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe gameplay where hiders use an in-game brush and color picker to paint their mannequin bodies to camouflage into the environment.

citations.review_text:
Rating: 9/10
Vibe: Pure, chaotic joy with a side of artistic panic.

If you are looking for a game to shake up your next game night or Discord hangout with friends, MECCHA CHAMELEON is an absolute must-buy. At its core, it takes the timeless formula of Prop Hunt, strips away the complicated mechanics, and replaces it with a brilliant twist: instead of turning into an object, you are a blank white mannequin who has to literally paint your own camouflage onto the environment.

Mecca is an amazing game with incredible mechanics. You color your body and come up with fun creative spots to hide. The only thing i dislike is some is the moderation. Since you can color and name yourself ANYTHING you can get some bad characters. However, i still encourage purchasing Mecca and playing with friends or randoms online.

[h1]Game for Artists but is capable of being game-friendly with non Artists.[/h1]

But this game gives you plenty of freedom for a hide & seek game unlike any others. Sure this game is meant to be played for you to be like a chameleon and hide in plain sight with a great camouflage that is hard to see with the naked eye. Yet it is still fun for us to play where if you have awesome skills in drawing gives great impressions but incompetency in this game would just lead to comedy.

I can't give an exact score since it's just a for fun game (I can't even call this a "Friend-Slop" because it is a unique hide & seek / prop hunt game), all I can say is that it is fun

claims.claim: Reviewers report encountering toxicity, racism, and cheating in public online lobbies.

citations.review_text: Amazing game, very fun. I can't seem to put it down honestly since it has been out, so why am I giving it a bad review? Well, it isn't the devs, it isn't the game, the gameplay, it is in fact the toxic player base. So many lobbies that are open and the host will just sit there and not start the match, the hacking is getting unbearable and the most recent annoyance is anyone who becomes a hunter will leave as soon as the match starts so you're stuck painting during a 4 min countdown just for the match to start and end abruptly. I think this game is going to chew itself out from the inside until the devs start actively putting effort into banning and punishing the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ that are killing it. I'm not saying they aren't working hard because they've been busting their asses as soon as this released to keep the updates flowing, but man the amount of players just running it in the dirt to be annoying is wild to me.

game is filled with way too many people cheating. The fact that people have to resort to cheat menus to win in a game with no prize or reward for finding everyone is insane. Also the game has a nasty habit of putting people into the void when matches start

So, what can be said it's a popular game that's exploding similarly to many games which have came before it. 
People love and hate cat & mouse games! They love the thrill of being hunted and then hate being the hunter and sometimes it's vice versa!! 

The game as a whole is a wonderful product and for the most part I absolutely love this game and it has become my communities new favorite party game because it offers a large lobby size and it's easy to adapt too with very little seriousness involved when playing with the correct people <-- Notice this is super important the correct people will determine if this game is correct for you. 

Let's get the negatives out of the way first; anytime any game in the market generates popularity you'll be overwhelmed by both great people looking to have a wonderful time giggling and experiencing joy, however; then on that same token you'll be overwhelmed by people whose whole goal in life is to troll, be toxic and cause problems for you and everyone they encounter. 

1. The game has a huge toxicity problem: From the overwhelming number of people being racist, people leaving the moment they spawn in as a hunter or are found and killed to quickly rage quitting, people being hateful within chat both vc and text, glitching outside the environment and even using hacks to guarantee a win. 

2. There's no way to ban or see who is talking or being disruptive: With all the toxicity within the games community there's no way to determine whose being toxic within the lobby as there's no voice flashing com's over a person or next to their name to help isolate whose causing disruption; the other issue is you can't completely ban people from your lobbies. You can kick them but unfortunately, they'll find your server and repeat the behavior and often they'll alter their screenname so you think it's a new person when in actuality it's the same troll with a different identity. 

Outside of those two things the game is relatively relaxing and chil…

This game is really fun to play as a hider or seeker. The only problem is the pixel art champions and cheese spots and straight up hackers. That lies outside of the games central theme though which is fun to play and great with friends.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the 3D color match tool can be inaccurate when trying to match colors to the environment.

citations.review_text:
Easily in the top 5 best games I've played all year, and for only $5!! Easy to hop into a game, play a round, and hop off if you have limited time. Or you can play with friends and find endless amounts of laughter. 

Meccha Chameleon takes a very simple concept like hide and seek and evolves it into something much more interesting and replayable than simple prop hunt games. Utilizing an in-game color picker to (mostly) accurately paint your body to match the surrounding colors from wherever you're hiding, combined with gestures and cloning, the possibilities are infinite in where you can hide. 

But that's not the kicker: The Workshop is FULL of maps from your favorite games, allowing you to let loose your inner child and finally play hide-and-seek in Kakariko Village from Ocarina of Time or Bikini Bottom from Spongebob. Once again, all of this is only $5!!

It is definitely a work-in-progress, but the dev(s) has been updating the game almost daily and adding really interesting features that makes hiding even more fun. However, the UI and settings desperately need to be worked on with players spamming taunts, voice chat bugging out, the inability to turn down audio tracks tied to maps, etc...

All in all, amazing game. It's only $5 (that's less than a fast food meal) and it will give you endless hours of fun.
This game is so crazy fun and its cool to see others artistic skills. Though the 3D color match is off a lot, the coloring part of this game is so fun. 10/10

claims.claim: Reviewers state that public lobbies suffer from disruptive behavior, including players leaving matches early when assigned to be the hunter.

citations.review_text:
I love this game. it combines art with a chill atmosphere and yet what feels like intense stakes of trying not to be found or finding others as quickly as you can.
I only have two frustrations. 
One, I wish the game would show previews of the modded maps so that I can know what type of character shape to pick ahead of the match starting.
Two, I wish there was some sort of consequence for players leaving the game early. There has been quite a few games as of late where the hunters will leave the game and waste the time of all the people hiding/painting because the hunter wait time keeps going until the game starts. Maybe if the hunter leaves, there can be a new hunter selection?

Amazing game, very fun. I can't seem to put it down honestly since it has been out, so why am I giving it a bad review? Well, it isn't the devs, it isn't the game, the gameplay, it is in fact the toxic player base. So many lobbies that are open and the host will just sit there and not start the match, the hacking is getting unbearable and the most recent annoyance is anyone who becomes a hunter will leave as soon as the match starts so you're stuck painting during a 4 min countdown just for the match to start and end abruptly. I think this game is going to chew itself out from the inside until the devs start actively putting effort into banning and punishing the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ that are killing it. I'm not saying they aren't working hard because they've been busting their asses as soon as this released to keep the updates flowing, but man the amount of players just running it in the dirt to be annoying is wild to me.
The servers are most of the time in terrible conditions. Many games are wasted with people leaving when they get hunter and a lot of the time is spent just trying to play the game.
